messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "your doctor may do further tests to diagnose the cause of your muscle problems"
set: ["your doctor may do further tests to diagnose the cause of your muscle problems", "your doctor may occasionally change your dose", "tell your doctor if your symptoms do not improve", "call your doctor if the child has memory problems", "report feelings of restlessness to your doctor", "report feelings of impulsivity to your doctor", "report feelings of agitation to your doctor", "report feelings of aggression to your doctor", "report feelings of irritability to your doctor", "report feelings of hostility to your doctor", "do not change your dose or stop without talking to your doctor", "kidney problems do not usually change your dose", "report anxiety to your doctor", "do not stop without speaking to your doctor first", "do not stop taking without talking to your doctor", "take your dose in the morning if your doctor tells you to"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
